matrix_definition: For each method-grid pair, retain the complete 2x2 overlap matrix O_ij=(s_1^2+s_2^2)/2, including both singular values and principal angles already present in source evidence.
delta_definition: For each matrix entry, compute delta_O_ij=O_ij(r=0.2)-O_ij(r=0.1). Diagonal and swapped score changes are respectively (delta_O_00+delta_O_11)/2 and (delta_O_01+delta_O_10)/2.
singular_channel_definition: For every entry and k in {1,2}, compute delta_(s_k^2)=s_k(r=0.2)^2-s_k(r=0.1)^2 and its overlap contribution delta_(s_k^2)/2.
ratio_policy: Compute after/before ratios and log2 ratios only when the denominator is positive; otherwise retain null. Do not normalize overlaps or use representation fidelity as a correction factor.
driver_policy: Within diagonal or swapped score groups, the driver entry is the largest absolute delta/2 contribution. Within each entry, the dominant singular channel is the largest absolute delta_(s_k^2)/2 contribution. These are numerical decomposition labels, not causal physical mechanisms.
representation_agreement: For each seed, grid and matrix entry, compare the sign of delta_O_ij between linear-point and cell-average representations; retain all 96 comparisons and do not hide disagreements.
source_policy: Read r=0.1 evidence from batches A and B and r=0.2 evidence from batch C. Do not recompute Floquet spectra or modify prior evidence. Independently recheck every decomposition from the stored source matrices.
